lg.l:
jalāṃ
copajalāṃ caiva yamunām abhito nadī
uśīnaro vai yatreṣṭā vāsavād aparicyatāṃ
taṃ tave samitaṃ tasya vāsavaś ca viśāṃ pate
abhyagacha nṛpavaraṃ jñātum agniś ca bhārata
jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmānam uśīnaraṃ

iṃdrā senā kapoto gni bhū
tvā yajñe pi jagmatuḥ
urū rājā samāsādya kapotā śyenajād bhayāt
śaraṇārthaṃ tadā rāṇilile bhayapīḍitaḥ
dharmānaṃ tv āhur ekaṃ sarve rāja mahīkṣitā

sa vai dharmaviruddhaṃ taṃ
kasmā karma cikīrṣasi
vihitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ rāja pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā
mā rakṣe dharmalebhena dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto mahādvijāḥ
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ gṛhātṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ

evam abhyāgata
syeha kapotasyābhayārthitaḥ
atra dāne paraṃ dharmaṃ katha syena na paśyasi
prasaṃdamānā saṃbhrānā kapotā śyena lakṣyate
matsakāśī jīvitārthī tasya tyāgo vigarhitāḥ
yo hi kaści dvijān hanyā grā vā lokasya mātaraṃ

śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyaja
te tulyaṃ teṣāṃ ca pātakaṃ
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti mahīpate
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ
śakyate dustyaje py arthe cirarātryāya jīvita
na tu bhojanam utsṛjya śakyaṃ vartuyata ciraṃ

bhakṣyā viyojitasyādya mama prā
ṇā viśāṃ pate
visṛjya kāyam eṣyaṃti paṃthānam akuto bhayaṃ
pramṛte mayi dharmātman_ putradāraṃ vinakṣyati
rakṣamānā kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇā ta rakṣyasi
dharmā yo bādhate dharmaṃ na sa dharmā kudharma tat

avirodhī tu yo dharmā sa dharmā satyavi
kramaḥ
virodhiṣu mahīpāla niścitya gurulāttavaṃ
na bādhā vidyate yatra sa dharmaṃ samudācaret
gurulāghavam ādāya dharmādharmaviniścayaṃ
yato bhūyāṃ tato rājan_ kuruṣva dharmaniścayaṃ

bahukalyāṇasaṃyukto vāṣyase vihago
tamaḥ
suparṇaḥ pakṣarāṭ_ kiṃ tvaṃ dharmaṃjñaś cāsyasaṃkṣayaṃ
tathā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ ca bhāṣase
āhārārthaṃ samārabha tava cāyaṃ vigaṃ mama
śakyaś cāpy anyathā kartum āhāro py adhigas tvayāḥ
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mṛgo vā mahiṣo pi vā

tvadartham a
dya kriyatāṃ ya cāsyad iha kiṃkṣasi
na varāhaṃ va cokṣāṇaṃ na mṛgā vividhāṃ tathāḥ
bhakṣayāmi mahārāja ki mamānye na kenacit
yas tu me daivavihito bhakṣā kṣatriyapuṃgavāḥ
tam utsṛja mahīpāla kapotam ivam eva me

śyenā kapotān a
tīti sthitir eṣā sanātanī
rājan sāram ajñātā kadalīskaṃdam āsajaḥ
rāṣṭraṃ śivīnām ṛddhaṃ vai dadāmi tava khecara
yaṃ ya kāmayase kāmaṃ śyena sarvaṃ dadāmi te
vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārthinam āgatāḥ

yenemaṃ varjaye
thās tvaṃ karmaṇā pakṣisatamaḥ
tadācakṣvā kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotaka
uśīnara kapoto te yadi sneho narādhipāḥ
ātmano māṃsam utkṛtya kapotaṃ tulayā dhṛtiṃ
yadā samaṃ kapotena tena māṃsaṃ narotamaḥ

tadā deyaṃ
tu tan mahya sā me tuṣṭi bhaviṣyati
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan mābhibhāṣase
tasmā te dya pradāsyāmi tvamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ
utkṛtya yat svayaṃ māṃsaṃ rājā paramadharmavit

tulayāmāsa kauteya kapotena saṃ
maṃ vibho
dhriyamāṇe kapotas tu māṃsenātiricyate
punaś cokṛtya māṃsāni rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samādhṛtiḥ
tata utkṛtyamāṃso sāv āruroha svayaṃ tulāṃ

idro ham asmi dharmajña kapoto
havyavāḍ ayaṃ
jijñāsamānau dharme tvāṃ yajñavāṭam upogatau
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhya utkṛtāni viśāṃ pate
eṣā te bhāsate kīrtir lokān abhibhaviṣyati
yāva loke manuṣyās tvāṃ kathayiṣyati pārthivaḥ
tāvat kīti ca lokāś ca sthāsyaṃti tava śāśvataḥ
ity evam uktā rājānam āharāha divaṃ punāḥ
uśīnaro pi dharmātmā dharmeṇāvṛtya rodasī
vibhrājamāno vapuṣā āharoha triviṣṭapaṃ
tad etat sadanaṃ rāja rājñā tasya mahātmanaḥ
paśyas tvai tan mayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapramocana

tatra vai satataṃ devā mu
nayaś ca sanātanaṃ
dṛśyaṃte brāhmaṇaṃ rājan puṇyavādbhi mahātmabhiḥ
